title: Stochastic Non-T\^atonnement Processes and the Attraction Principle
abstract: arXiv:2509.17248v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: I introduce stochastic non-t\^atonnement processes and argue that they are a natural outcome of general equilibrium theory. To this end, I revisit classical demand theory to define two diffeomorphisms: the normalized Walrasian demand and a map that flattens indifference hypersurfaces. These diffeomorphisms are applied to the three canonical manifolds in the consumption domain (i.e., the indifference and the offer hypersurfaces, and the trade hyperplane) to analyze their images in the normalized and flat domains, and their relations to the set of Pareto optimal allocations are discussed. Then, I derive, for arbitrary non-t\^atonnement processes, an attraction principle based on the dynamics of marginal rates of substitution seen on the floor of the flat domain. translated_title: 随机非试探过程与吸引原理
translated_abstract: 我引入了随机非试探过程，并论证它们是一般均衡理论的天然产物。为此，我重新审视经典需求理论，定义了两个微分同胚：规范化瓦尔拉斯需求，以及一个使无差异超曲面平坦化的映射。这些微分同胚被应用于消费域中的三个典范流形（即无差异超曲面、提供超曲面和交易超平面），以分析它们在规范化域与平坦域中的像，并讨论了它们与帕累托最优配置集合之间的关系。随后，对于任意非试探过程，我基于在平坦域底面上观察到的边际替代率动态，推导出一个吸引原理。该原理促成了随机非试探过程的定义，并导出了第一福利定理的随机版本。当效用函数……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将随机非试探过程作为一般均衡理论的天然产物引入，借助规范化瓦尔拉斯需求与无差异超曲面平坦化这两个微分同胚，推导出基于边际替代率动态的吸引原理，并由此得到第一福利定理的随机版本。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces stochastic non-tâtonnement processes as a natural outcome of general equilibrium theory, derives an attraction principle from the dynamics of marginal rates of substitution via two diffeomorphisms (normalized Walrasian demand and indifference-flattening map), and obtains a stochastic version of the First Welfare Theorem.
